mapper.insert: insert into pay_order(user_id, product_id, product_name, out_trade_no, order_time, total_amount, original_amount, order_type, coupon_ids, status, out_trade_time, create_time, update_time) values(#{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{outTradeNo}, #{orderTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{originalAmount}, #{orderType}, #{couponIds}, #{status}, #{outTradeTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update pay_order set pay_url = #{payUrl}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
update pay_order set status = 'CLOSE', pay_time = now(), update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
mapper.select: select product_id, product_name, out_trade_no, order_time, total_amount, order_type, status, pay_url from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId} order by id desc limit 1

select user_id, product_id, product_name, out_trade_no, order_time, total_amount, original_amount, order_type, coupon_ids, status, pay_url, pay_time, out_trade_time from pay_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} limit 1

select id, user_id, product_id, product_name, out_trade_no, order_time, total_amount, original_amount, order_type, coupon_ids, status, pay_url, pay_time, out_trade_time from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and order_type = 'CART' and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT') order by id desc limit 1
SELECT out_trade_no as outTradeNo FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND order_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) ORDER BY order_time ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT out_trade_no as outTradeNo FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND order_time <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) ORDER BY order_time ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.product_name, o.out_trade_no, o.order_time, o.total_amount, o.order_type, o.status, o.pay_url, o.pay_time, o.out_trade_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM pay_order o
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
